lead.t: A cohort study is an observational epidemiological study in which a group of individuals sharing a common exposure or characteristic is followed over time to determine the incidence of a particular health outcome.

snip.t: A cohort study is an observational epidemiological study in which a group of individuals sharing a common exposure or characteristic is followed over time to determine the incidence of a particular health outcome.
Prospective cohort study:Participants are enrolled based on current exposure status.
Cohort study: Categorizes participants by exposure status and follows them over time to assess incidence of outcomes.

qs.q: A cohort study examines the relationship between extended working hours and major depressive disorder among healthcare workers, reporting an odds ratio of 1.75. Which reported statistical parameter best reflects the precision of this estimated effect size?
qs.e: The 95% confidence interval indicates the range of values within which the true population effect size likely falls, with a narrower interval reflecting higher precision. The p-value indicates statistical significance relative to the null hypothesis but does not quantify the precision of the point estimate.
